# Overview

:::caution Mainnet is not live
ZEL mainnet has not launched yet. The values below are placeholders and will be updated with the production release.
:::

- Chain id: `zel_935-1`
- zel-cored binary (linux/amd64): to be published
- Genesis file: to be published
- App.toml file: to be published
- Trust height: to be published
- Trust hash: to be published
- Minimal stake: to be published
- Denom name: `uzel`
- Total supply: to be published

:::warning
To connect to the Mainnet chain you should request the following information from our team:

- IP addresses of nodes with corresponding seeds to satisfy `persistent_peers` and `rpc_servers`;
- Trusted height (if changed);
- Trusted hash (if changed);
- Actual core version (if changed);

Also, to become a validator you may need to receive tokens from our team.
:::
